(()=>{const out={};for(const tr of [PT8.RING_IDX,14]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,circuit:true,track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;const S={dn:[0,0,0,0],up:[0,0,0,0],fl:[0,0,0,0]};for(let i=0;i<60*600;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count'&&i>60*20)RACE.state='race';if((c.lapT||[]).length>=1)break;if(RACE.state!=='race'||c.sp<20)continue;const k=c.idx,g=(T.y[(k+4)%N]-T.y[k])/(4*T.sp),nG=c.m.wheels.filter(w=>w.g).length,vr=Math.abs(-c.vx*Math.cos(c.yaw)+c.vz*Math.sin(c.yaw));const b=g<-.03?S.dn:g>.03?S.up:S.fl;b[0]++;if(nG<4)b[1]++;if(nG<2)b[2]++;b[3]+=vr}for(const k in S){const b=S[k];out[tr+k]=[b[0],+(b[1]/b[0]).toFixed(3),+(b[2]/b[0]).toFixed(3),+(b[3]/b[0]).toFixed(2)]}out[tr+'lap']=c.lapT}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
